props.name: autofocus
props.description: Whether the first input should automatically receive focus on mount.

props.name: autofocusDelay
props.description: Delay in milliseconds before automatically focusing.

props.name: autoSubmit
props.description: Whether to submit the owning form when the pin input becomes complete.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Default uncontrolled value.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the input is disabled.

props.name: form
props.description: Form ID to associate with the hidden input.

props.name: id
props.description: The ID of the input element.

props.name: inputMode
props.description:
The virtual keyboard hint applied to the inputs and hidden input.
Overrides the `inputMode` derived from `validationType`.

props.name: inputsRef
props.description: Ref collection for the individual input elements.

props.name: length
props.description: The number of input fields.

props.name: mask
props.description: Whether to treat the inputs like passwords by masking the value.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the input element, used for form submission.

props.name: normalizeValue
props.description:
Normalizes a proposed value after `validationType` filtering; the result is
filtered again and clamped to `length`. Applied to string `value`/`defaultValue`
and to typed, pasted, or autofilled text.
Should be idempotent, since it may run on the same value more than once.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Native blur event when focus leaves the pin input group.

props.name: onComplete
props.description:
Callback when all input fields are completely filled.
For controlled values it fires once the value is actually applied.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Native focus event when focus enters the pin input group.

props.name: onFocusIn
props.description:
Native focusin event for every slot focus, including moves between slots.
Calling `preventDefault` skips `onFocus`.

props.name: onFocusOut
props.description:
Native focusout event for every slot blur, including moves between slots.
Calling `preventDefault` skips `onBlur`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Callback when the pin input value changes, passing the slot characters as an array.

props.name: onValueInvalid
props.description:
Callback when entered text contains characters rejected by `validationType`
or `normalizeValue`. Receives the raw entered text before filtering.

props.name: otp
props.description: Whether to enable One-Time Password autocomplete (`one-time-code`).

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder character displayed in empty inputs.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the input is read-only.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref for the root container element.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the input is required.

props.name: separator
props.description:
Group inputs by inserting a separator between them.
Pass `true` to split inputs in half, a number to insert one after every Nth input,
or an array of positions to insert after specific inputs.

props.name: separatorRender
props.description: Custom renderer for the separator between inputs.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size of the component.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: translations
props.description: Localized message overrides for this pin input instance.

props.name: validationType
props.description: Type of characters allowed in the inputs.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value as an array of characters or joined string.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual treatment of the component.
